title: Mixed Event — Doll Festival at the Tenma's — Episode8 The Truth Behind That Smile

meta.Episode: Episode8 — The Truth Behind That Smile
meta.Event Outline: It's the first Doll Festival since Saki returned to school! In the midst of his enthusiastic preparations, Tsukasa looks back on a bitter childhood memory. He then executes his plan to do something special for Saki, but will it go as he hopes...?!

rows.Line: Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-Why are you apologizing, Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, why are you...?!
I thought you were mad at me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, never!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It was all my fault!
You did nothing wrong!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Honami told me everything! She said that you were feeling sad over me not being here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hona did...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She did! She even came all the way over to my school to tell me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I'm sorry for not replying to your text! I forgot to take my phone with me and didn't know that you'd sent me anything!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Your lunch and your phone...
You really are a big forgetter.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ouch...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm sorry! What I did made you worry and feel uneasy...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I tried to swap out your precious dolls without actually considering how you'd feel about it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I just ended up hurting you instead...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I just wanted you to be happy, Saki.
Just like that time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I always just end up making you feel worse...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm a disgrace as a big brother...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No! Don't say that...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's true that I did feel sad...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really did think you forgot about that day...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But that's no excuse for saying the things I did... I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But can you at least tell me this? What am I forgetting about that day exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I ran over to the hospital to bring you those dolls, fell and got them dirty...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you looked so sad as you held them in your hands. That's all I honestly remember.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You made yourself smile to keep me from worrying any more...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, I made myself smile...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...! Now I get it!
It all makes sense now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, you have it all wrong.
I wasn't making myself smile or anything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was so happy that you came, I almost started to cry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I thought you'd feel terrible if I started crying and you wanted me to be happy so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I might've ended up making a weird smile...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, so you really were happy that time...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I was so unbelievably happy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was so happy that you brought me my dolls even after getting covered in scrapes and bruises.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No matter how dirty these dolls get, they'll always mean everything to me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I thought when you bought me those new dolls that you'd completely forgotten about what happened with the old ones. That's why I felt so sad.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I'm glad I was wrong.
You still remembered!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course I did! How can I forget something like that...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I misunderstood you as well, Saki. I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, you don't have to apologize.
I should be the one to...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I always kept how I actually felt a secret to make sure you wouldn't worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I couldn't just say what I really meant. I just smiled and nodded. It's no wonder that you didn't understand how I really felt, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I made you go through all of that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And thank you so much. You bringing me my dolls was one of the happiest moments of my life!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, my one and only big brother...
I'm proud to be your little sister!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: SAKIIII!!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! Tsukasa, too loud! You're gonna make our neighbors wonder what's going on...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki!! My precious little sister! The best little sister anyone could ask for!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now it makes sense...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I'm glad they made up... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, good evening...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, good evening...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Huff*... *Huff*...
Tsukasa's... Too fast...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami? Did you run here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I did... Tsukasa just ran off so fast...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But, oh...
Have they already made up?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Nice work, Honami.
Thank you, as always.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just glad Saki's smiling again.
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um... Is it really alright for me to stay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! You were a huge help this time around!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I still don't feel like I did much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much too, Hona! I don't think we could've made up if it weren't for you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I just talked a little about what happened, but I'm glad I could help...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! How's about we get this party started?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I, of course, will be the MC!
The pegasus that soars through the...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, before you start!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! Wh-What is it?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Can you bring the dolls you bought here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, why...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You bought them just for me, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think we should celebrate using the new dolls too♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed, we should! We can celebrate using both the old and new ones!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: While we're at it, why not take a picture with them?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let's start with Saki then.
Smile, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A lovely smile, Saki!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, stop!

Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... I wonder if Tsukasa and Saki made up already...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Who knows? But Mochizuki at least seems reliable, so I'm sure they're fine now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe. He hasn't come back, so it's probably a good sign.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: True. It does feel that way. I'm sure he's also enjoying the party as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup♪
I think so too☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right! So why don't we have some fun too☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, does everyone have a drink ready?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm ready♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Then let's welcome Luka♪
And let's get our Doll Festival party started♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Cheers☆

rows.Speaker: Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Cheers♪
